tools.name: get_about
tools.description: Get information about Danny Keane -- who he is, his career, skills, and background. Pass section for just the story or just the career table.

tools.name: get_work_history
tools.description: Get Danny Keane's full work history including roles at Guild.ai, Jasper, Titan, Google/YouTube, Zesty, and side projects. Pass company for one role in detail.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get Danny Keane's contact information including email, LinkedIn, Twitter, GitHub, and Figma. Pass channel for one of them.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Get the full content of a specific page on dannykeane.com by slug: about, contact, privacy, developers, or habbo. Returns the page's document content, not a summary.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_contact, get_page · Public sink: get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: get_contact, get_page · Public sink: get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
